name: The Heist: Monaco
source:
A master thief is betrayed by a member of their crew, resulting in someone they care about getting arrested. Three years later, they are approached by the their old right-hand, who offers a proposition to put together a new gang, get revenge on the traitor, and humiliate an old enemy in the process.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:The_Heist:_Monaco]Choices Wikia[/url]]
